defect: SMP_READ read_bytes() accepted a reply containing more unpacked bytes than the requested 2-byte pair count and silently returned only the prefix, and truncated replies could raise uncaught IndexError instead of a fail-closed SlotError. An invalid or corrupted read frame can therefore pass a readback response-shape check, although subsequent CRC may still detect content corruption. No physical data-loss claim.
change: Require at least four echoed reply header bytes plus packed data; allow only the single extra byte required by an odd pair-count request; reject all larger decoded replies as SlotError before returning backup/readback bytes.
